data.about_the_company: TARC Limited is an India-based real estate development company headquartered in New Delhi, with its registered office at C-3, Qutab Institutional Area, Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi. The company is engaged in developing and constructing residential, commercial, township, SEZ, IT park, and mall projects, and it also sells real estate units such as land, plots, apartments, and commercial spaces while earning rental income from investment properties. TARC was incorporated in 2016, formerly operated under the name Anant Raj Global Limited, and changed its name to TARC Limited in April 2021 following a demerger from the Anant Raj group. It is listed on both the NSE and BSE, trades under the ticker TARC, and is led by Amar Sarin, who has guided its repositioning toward luxury and design-led residential development in the Delhi and NCR markets.
